Non-Surgical Body Contouring

Stubborn belly fat, soft arms, loose skin after weight loss or a tummy that changed after pregnancy? Body contouring at Facelit shapes the areas diet and exercise can't reach. We combine muscle toning, skin tightening and doctor-led weight management into one plan, with no surgery and no downtime.

Overview

What is Body Contouring?

Body contouring reshapes specific parts of your body by reducing stubborn fat, building muscle tone and tightening loose skin. It's different from weight loss: weight loss makes you smaller overall, while contouring shapes where it matters, like the tummy, waist, arms and thighs.

At Facelit, every plan is doctor-led and non-surgical. We start by measuring your body with a body composition analysis, then match you with the right mix of treatments: CM Slim for muscle and fat, Ultraformer III HIFU and Profhilo Body for loose skin, and medical weight management when you need to lose weight first.

Read more: why stubborn fat won't shift

Some areas, like the lower tummy, love handles and inner thighs, have fat cells that are slow to release their stored fat. Hormones, genetics, pregnancy and age all play a part. That's why many people lose weight everywhere except these areas.

Targeted treatments work directly on these areas, and building the muscle underneath gives a firmer, more defined shape.

1. MeasureBody composition analysis shows your fat, muscle and visceral fat.
2. ShapeTreatments tone muscle, reduce fat and tighten skin where you need it.
3. MaintainCoaching and retests help you keep your new shape.

Tap a number to see what's causing the problem and which Facelit treatments can help.

Tap a number to see the right treatments.

A double chin and soft jawline can make you look heavier than you are. Deep focused ultrasound tightens the skin and firms the area under the chin.

Upper arms often stay soft even after weight loss. We combine muscle toning with skin tightening for firmer, more defined arms.

Weight loss vs contouring

What's the Difference?

Weight loss
Reduces your overall body weight and fat, including visceral fat around your organs. It improves health markers like blood sugar and blood pressure.
Body contouring
Shapes specific areas by toning muscle, reducing local fat and tightening skin. It doesn't replace weight loss, but it finishes the job.
Why you often need both
Weight loss brings you to a healthy size. Contouring deals with the stubborn spots and loose skin that weight loss leaves behind.
Where to start
If your BMI is 25 or above, we usually start with weight loss. If you're close to your goal, you can go straight to contouring.

Common problems

Problems We Solve Every Day

Tap a problem that sounds like yours.

"My tummy won't go, even at the gym."
Lower-tummy fat is one of the most stubborn areas. CM Slim tones the core and reduces fat right where you need it.
"I lost weight but my skin is loose."
Skin needs help to tighten after big weight loss. HIFU and Profhilo Body firm it up without surgery.
"My body changed after pregnancy."
Core muscles separate and weaken, and skin stretches. We rebuild the core, tighten skin and strengthen the pelvic floor.
"I have PCOS and gain weight easily."
Hormones make weight harder to manage. A doctor-led plan with the right diet and medical support makes a real difference.
"I keep losing and regaining weight."
Crash diets burn muscle and slow metabolism. We track fat and muscle with body composition tests so you lose the right kind of weight.
"I don't have time for long treatments."
Most sessions take 30 to 60 minutes with no downtime. Many people fit them into a lunch break.

Your plan

How Your Body Contouring Plan Works

We start with the full picture.

  • A doctor consultation about your goals, health and history.
  • A body composition analysis to measure fat, muscle and visceral fat.
  • Blood tests if needed, for thyroid, PCOS or blood sugar.
  • Photos and measurements to track progress.

Your treatments, in the right order.

  • Weight loss first, if needed.
  • CM Slim to tone muscle and reduce stubborn fat.
  • HIFU or Profhilo Body to tighten loose skin.
  • Nutrition and coaching support throughout.

Results you can measure.

  • Body composition retests every 4 to 8 weeks.
  • Before-and-after photos and measurements.
  • Plan adjustments based on your numbers.
  • Maintenance sessions and coaching to keep results.

Results

What Results Can You Expect?

Non-surgical results build gradually and look natural.

  1. Weeks 1–4

    Feel the change

    Firmer muscles, better energy and early changes on the tape measure.

  2. Months 1–3

    See the change

    Toned muscle, less stubborn fat and tighter skin.

  3. Months 3–6

    Your new shape

    Weight-loss and contouring results come together.

  4. Ongoing

    Keep it

    A stable weight, activity and occasional maintenance keep your results.

Illustrative model images. Results vary with your body, plan and lifestyle.

Make it last

Habits That Protect Your Results

Simple everyday habits that keep your new shape.

  • Protein at every meal to protect muscle
  • Fewer fried snacks and sugary drinks
  • Smaller portions of rice and refined carbs
  • Plenty of vegetables, dal and fruit
  • A 30-minute walk most days
  • Strength work 2 to 3 times a week
  • Take the stairs and move every hour
  • 7 to 8 hours of sleep
  • Manage stress, which drives belly fat
  • Drink 2 to 3 litres of water a day

Myths vs facts

Body Contouring Myths, Busted

"Contouring is a quick way to lose weight."
Contouring shapes areas. Overall weight loss needs a weight management plan.
"You can spot-reduce fat with crunches."
Exercise alone rarely shifts fat from one spot. Targeted treatments can.
"Non-surgical means no results."
Results are gradual and natural, and they're real, especially with a good plan.
"Once done, you never need to do anything again."
A stable weight and active lifestyle keep your results.
"It's only for women."
Many men use contouring for the tummy, love handles, chest-to-waist shape and double chin.

Safety first

Who Body Contouring Suits, and Who Should Wait

Our treatments are non-invasive, but some health conditions mean certain treatments aren't suitable.

Common and temporary

  • Muscle soreness after CM Slim, like after a workout
  • Mild redness or tenderness after HIFU
  • Small bumps for a day after Profhilo Body

Tell your doctor if you

  • Are pregnant or recently gave birth
  • Have a pacemaker, metal implants or a copper IUD
  • Have had recent surgery in the area
  • Have a hernia, heart condition or other medical condition
  • Take regular medicines

Questions

Body Contouring FAQs

What is body contouring?
Body contouring means reshaping specific areas of the body by reducing stubborn fat, toning muscle and tightening loose skin. At Facelit we use non-surgical treatments, so there are no cuts and no downtime.
Is body contouring the same as weight loss?
No. Weight loss reduces your overall body weight. Body contouring shapes specific areas like the tummy, arms or thighs. Many people do both: lose weight first, then contour the areas that are left.
What treatments are used for non-surgical body contouring?
At Facelit we use CM Slim (electromagnetic muscle toning), HIFU body tightening with Ultraformer III and Profhilo Body, alongside medical weight management, weight-loss injections, nutrition counselling and body composition analysis.
Which areas can be treated?
The tummy, love handles, buttocks, arms, thighs, calves, double chin and neck.
Am I a good candidate?
Body contouring works best if you're at or close to a healthy weight and have stubborn areas or loose skin. If you have more weight to lose, we'll start with a medical weight plan.
What BMI is best for body contouring?
For Indian adults, a BMI below about 25 is ideal for contouring alone. Above that, a weight-loss plan usually comes first. Use our BMI checker above as a guide.
How many sessions will I need?
It depends on the treatment and area. CM Slim is usually 4 sessions over 2 weeks per area. HIFU is often 1 to 3 sessions, and Profhilo Body is 2 sessions a month apart.
When will I see results?
Muscle toning and skin tightening build over 2 to 3 months. Weight-loss programmes show steady changes over 3 to 6 months.
Is non-surgical body contouring safe?
Yes, for suitable people when planned by doctors. The treatments are non-invasive, need no anaesthesia and have little or no downtime. We screen everyone for things like implants, pregnancy and medical conditions first.
Is it painful?
Most treatments are comfortable. CM Slim feels like an intense workout, and HIFU causes warm, tingling sensations. Settings are adjusted to your comfort.
How long do results last?
Results last well if you keep a stable weight and stay active. Some treatments benefit from maintenance sessions every few months.
Can I do body contouring after pregnancy?
Yes, once your doctor confirms you've healed, usually several months after delivery, and later after a C-section. We often combine core toning, skin tightening and pelvic floor strengthening.
Non-surgical contouring vs liposuction: which is better?
Liposuction removes more fat in one go but needs surgery and recovery time. Non-surgical contouring is gentler, with no downtime, and suits people with smaller stubborn areas and loose skin.
Where can I get body contouring in Kerala?
Facelit offers body contouring and weight management at our clinics in Trivandrum, Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur). Some technologies, like CM Slim and Ultraformer III, are at our Trivandrum clinic.
How much does body contouring cost?
It depends on the treatments, areas and number of sessions in your plan. Book a consultation and we'll give you a clear, personalised quote.
